correctness.rationale: Brownian reflection for a pinned bridge from positive endpoints u,v gives P(path stays nonnegative|u,v)=1-exp(-2uv), and zero otherwise. Hence S is Gaussian positive-orthant mass minus a weighted Gaussian quadrant integral. Rescaling gives J(tau)=integral_0^infty dt/(t²-2tau t+1), with tau=rho-2r det(C)/sqrt(vw), and explicit branches; large negative tau gives logarithmic deficit (log r)/(4pi r sqrt(det C)) for fixed positive definite C. Rank-one Y=aZ yields elementary Gaussian transform and r^-1/2 deficit when a0a1>0, zero otherwise. Independently evaluated 20 correlated Gaussian positive-quadrant integrals. Limits are fixed covariance and no uniform rank crossover is proved.
